🟢 2) PatchNet, Point2Surf, Point2Shape, SurfaceRecon

These are effectively CAD-recon engines because they reconstruct smooth patch surfaces instead of raw meshes.

🟢 hustvl/surface-recon (HF YES)

On HuggingFace → YES

Very good for CAD-like patch reconstruction

autodesk/feature-detection-cad

hustvl/cad-features
Perfect for reverse engineering smooth surfaces
→ Use it for “Mesh → Smooth CAD Surfaces (SDF / patches)”.

🟢 threedvision/point2surf (HF mirror exists)

Implicit patches / local MLP surfaces

Great for CAD-like geometry
→ Use it for mesh smoothing, high-quality patch surfacing.

🟢 zju3dv/patchnetsurface (HF reuploads exist)

Patch-level neural surface surfaces
→ Closest to NURBS-like reconstruction.

🟢 kaist-3d/point2shape (HF YES)

Patches + primitive blending
→ Good for engineering-like primitives.
